subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — model fit & unexpected quality regression
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-retail.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22 09:15 PDT
Subject: Post-demo recap + next steps (model fit + evals)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- What we learned: Acme Retail wants a LLM-based answers layer for product search assistance with a strict correctness bar (price/availability truthfulness) and sub-200ms median latency for common queries.
- Recommended models: our curated small-medium candidate set (redwood-mini-v2, redwood-medium-q4) gave the best cost/latency tradeoffs in our initial evals — see attached eval_report_q2.pdf.
- Prompt sets: I’ve attached prompt_set_v3.json with the baseline prompts we used; these will be the first iteration for your in-house evals.

Next steps: 
1) You to run the prompt_set_v3 against your sample catalog and share any failing examples (Sarah).
2) We’ll provision a pinned endpoint with redwood-medium-q4 for a 2-week evaluation window (Marissa -> provisioning).
3) Engineering sync if you see any quality regressions post-provision (Rishi / Vivek looped).

I’ll follow up with a brief timeline and a link to the shared folder.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

---
Attachments: eval_report_q2.pdf, prompt_set_v3.json

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22 10:02 PDT
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (model fit + evals)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and the prompt set. Tom and I ran a quick smoke test against a 500-item slice. Most looked good, but we saw a worrying pattern with the new redwood-medium-q4 model:

- Several price-related responses were hallucinated (e.g., returned old sale prices).
- A handful of product availability queries returned generic "check back later" rather than the catalog truth.

I attached a small sample_diffs.txt with 7 example prompts and expected vs actual. Can we pause the rollout? If the model is returning incorrect product data, that risks our storefront UX.

We’re happy to share logs and deeper samples; Tom can follow up with the dataset.

—Sarah
Director, Search & Personalization | Acme Retail
sarah.lee@acme-retail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22 10:30 PDT
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (model fit + evals)

Sarah — thanks for the quick repros, very helpful. Apologies for the friction. I’m looping in Rishi (ML lead) and Vivek (infra) to triage.

Immediate ask from our side: can you confirm whether the examples in sample_diffs.txt are from the catalog snapshot you uploaded this morning, and whether any caching/proxy layers sit in front of your catalog API? That helps us quickly rule out staleness vs model hallucination.

Proposal: we can
- Pin your evaluation endpoint to the prior version (redwood-medium-q3) to stop regressions while we investigate, OR
- Roll back the specific model variant to a last-known-good commit (we can do this within the hour if you prefer).

Which would you prefer as a temporary mitigation?

I’ll prepare the pinned endpoint and a short rollback playbook once Rishi confirms.

Best,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22 11:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (model fit + evals)

Hi Sarah / team —

Thanks for the examples, Sarah — I pulled sample_diffs.txt. Initial quick checks:
- The failure modes look like a model-output fidelity regression rather than external caching. The timestamps in the prompts map to your uploaded snapshot.
- I’ll run a batch diff between redwood-medium-q3 (last-known-good) and redwood-medium-q4 across your prompt_set_v3 now. Expect a short report in ~90 minutes.

Short-term mitigation options:
1) Pin to redwood-medium-q3 (recommended) — this is non-disruptive and we can swap back when we have a fix.
2) Apply a conservative output filter / post-processing rule for price and availability responses — lower-risk but may reduce helpfulness on some queries.

I’ll include per-example confidence scores + token-level differences in the report. If you want the immediate rollback/pin, Marissa, I can trigger it once you confirm.

—Rishi
Staff ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22 13:10 PDT
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (model fit + evals)

Thanks Rishi — pinning to redwood-medium-q3 sounds good to us. Please go ahead with the pin/rollback while you investigate. We’d like a timeline for root cause and a plan to validate fixes against our prompt set before unpinning.

Tom will upload additional failing cases to the Drive folder (link in your folder).

—Sarah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22 17:40 PDT
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (model fit + evals)

Sarah — confirming we have scheduled the pin to redwood-medium-q3 for your evaluation endpoint. Details: 
- Action: pin endpoint to redwood-medium-q3 (version v3.12.1)
- ETA: rollback/pin complete by 18:15 PDT today
- Owner: Rishi (investigation) + Vivek (infra rollback + routing)
- Deliverables: batch diff report (redwood-medium-q3 vs q4) + per-prompt confidence scores, validation checklist for unpin (expected by 2027-05-24 EOD)

We’ve also uploaded the sample diffs you sent into the shared folder and added initial annotations (see related link). I’ll keep you posted in this thread and we’ll set a sync if you prefer a live walk-through of the diff results.

Thanks everyone — we’ll touch base once the rollback is confirmed.

Best,
Marissa

---
Attachments: sample_diffs.txt
